_comment: Roast times and temperatures. Every figure carries a source key. Timing formula from Q Guild: minutes = per_450g * (weight_g / 450) + extra. Totals are rounded UP to the next 5 minutes. Do not add a figure without a source.

qguild.name: Q Guild, Recommended Cooking Times (butchers' guild leaflet)

fsa.name: Food Standards Agency, Safer Food Better Business: Cooking safely

usda.name: FoodSafety.gov (USDA), Meat and poultry roasting charts

fan_rule.text: For a fan oven, set it 10 to 20°C lower. Cooking times stay the same.

carryover.text: Meat keeps cooking while it rests. Take it out about 5 to 10°C below the target and let the rest finish it.

fsa_core.text: The FSA's safe core temperature and time combinations are 70°C for 2 minutes, 75°C for 30 seconds or 80°C for 6 seconds.

meats.name: Turkey
meats.label: Whole turkey

stages.note: for the rest of the time

core.text: 75°C in the thickest part of the thigh, and in the centre of any stuffing

meats.check: No pink meat, the juices run clear and it's piping hot all the way through.

meats.name: Turkey breast joint
meats.label: Boned and rolled turkey breast
meats.check: No pink meat, the juices run clear and it's piping hot in the centre.
meats.tip: Uncover for the last 20 to 30 minutes to crisp the skin.

meats.name: Chicken
meats.label: Whole chicken

core.text: 75°C in the thickest part, between the breast and the leg

meats.check: No pink meat, the juices run clear where the thigh meets the body and it's piping hot.

meats.name: Beef
meats.label: Beef joint
meats.pink_ok: Whole beef joints can be served pink as long as the whole outside surface is properly cooked, because bacteria are only on the surface. Rolled or stuffed joints are different: cook them all the way through.

meats.name: Lamb
meats.label: Lamb joint

core.text: 70 to 75°C for medium, 75 to 80°C for well done

meats.pink_ok: A whole leg or shoulder can be served pink as long as the whole outside surface is properly cooked. Rolled or stuffed joints must be cooked all the way through.

meats.name: Pork
meats.label: Pork joint

rest.text: 20 minutes, uncovered so the crackling stays crisp

meats.check: No pink or red in the juices, and it's hot all the way through. Pork shouldn't be served rare.

meats.name: Gammon
meats.label: Gammon or ham joint

core.text: 70°C in the centre for at least 2 minutes

meats.check: Gammon stays pink when it's cooked because it's cured, so colour won't tell you. Use a thermometer, or check the juices run clear and it's piping hot in the middle.
meats.tip: To boil and roast, simmer for half the total time then roast for the other half. Cover the glaze with foil if it starts to catch.
